validation_criteria: Blocking behavior is observed during single insert operations.
Wait type LCK_M_S is confirmed in sys.dm_exec_requests.
The presence of 34 indexes is confirmed to impact insert performance.
symptom_evidence: Single insert takes an unusually long time.
Blocking session ID is reported but not active.
mechanism_evidence: Blocking caused by uncommitted transactions holding locks.
Excessive index maintenance during inserts contributes to poor performance.
